instruction: Paul asked me for my song recommendations over email. I started drafting the response email off the top of my head. But then realized I can mine it from my Spotify account! Please update the email draft with all of my liked songs that are in my song or album library or any of my plalists. Keep the existing format of the email, making changes only to the song entries. Once done, send the email.

def fetch_all(func, access_token, page_limit=20, **kwargs):
    page_index = 0
    all_items = []
    while True:
        page = func(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, **kwargs)
        if not page:
            break
        all_items.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

print('liked_songs in globals:', 'liked_songs' in globals(), 'len:', len(liked_songs) if 'liked_songs' in globals() else None)

liked_song_map = {s['song_id']: s for s in liked_songs}
liked_ids = set(liked_song_map.keys())
print('liked_ids count:', len(liked_ids))

# Fetch songs in song library
song_lib_ids = set()
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    song_lib_ids.update([s['song_id'] for s in page])
    page_index += 1
print('song_lib_ids count:', len(song_lib_ids))

# Fetch songs in album library (all song_ids within those albums)
alb_lib_ids = set()
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        alb_lib_ids.update(a.get('song_ids', []))
    page_index += 1
print('alb_lib_ids count:', len(alb_lib_ids))

# Fetch songs in playlist library
pl_lib_ids = set()
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    for p in page:
        pl_lib_ids.update(p.get('song_ids', []))
    page_index += 1
print('pl_lib_ids count:', len(pl_lib_ids))

union_ids = song_lib_ids | alb_lib_ids | pl_lib_ids
print('union_ids count:', len(union_ids))

# Target liked songs
target_ids = [sid for sid in liked_song_map.keys() if sid in union_ids]
print('target_ids count:', len(target_ids))
print('target first 10:', target_ids[:10])
# Order according to liked_songs list
ordered_targets = [s for s in liked_songs if s['song_id'] in union_ids]
print('ordered_targets count:', len(ordered_targets))
print('ordered_targets sample:', [(s['song_id'], s['title'], [a['name'] for a in s['artists']]) for s in ordered_targets[:5]])

bullet_lines = []
for s in ordered_targets:
    title = s['title']

    bullet_lines.append(f"- {title} by {', '.join(artist_names)}")

# Build updated draft body keeping existing format, replacing only bullet entries
old_body = draft['body']
lines = old_body.splitlines()
# Identify contiguous bullet block containing lines starting with '- '
bullet_idxs = [i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.strip().startswith('- ') and ' by ' in l]
print('bullet_idxs:', bullet_idxs)

new_lines = []
if bullet_idxs:
    new_lines = lines[:bullet_idxs[0]] + bullet_lines + lines[bullet_idxs[-1]+1:]
else:
    # fallback: just insert after first line
    new_lines = lines[:1] + bullet_lines + lines[1:]
new_body = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print('new_body:\n', new_body)
print('new_body line count:', len(new_body.splitlines()))
